title: Invoice Generator
description: A full-stack web application that helps you manage clients and create professional invoices with PDF export capabilities. Built with React for an intuitive frontend, Node.js/Express for the backend API, and Prisma with SQLite for robust data management.

title: Sandoval Roofing
description: Sandoval Roofing is a professional client-side business website built for a locally-based roofing contractor in Valley Center, CA. The site showcases residential and commercial roofing services, including repairs, re-roofing, inspections, and storm damage repair. Built with modern web technologies to provide a responsive, user-friendly experience for potential customers seeking trusted roofing solutions.
